collate_dinov2_samples: collate a list of DINOv2 sample batches with global and local crops into stacked tensors
generate_mask_indices: generate random mask indices for a subset of samples using a configurable mask ratio and probability
compute_masks_weight: compute inverse-frequency weights for masked tokens to balance loss across samples with different mask counts
cast_collated_tensors: cast collated global and local crop tensors to a specified PyTorch dtype like torch.half
shuffle_and_stack_masks: shuffle the generated masks across samples and stack them into a single collated mask tensor
